name: Arizona

jury_list.statute: A.R.S. 21-312(A)-(B): the juror list and juror information 'shall not be released unless specifically required by law or ordered by the court'; records with juror biographical information are closed. Ariz. R. Sup. Ct. 123(e)(10) also makes questionnaire information confidential.
jury_list.holder: Jury commissioner / superior court. Juror non-citizen notices go to the Secretary of State and county recorder (A.R.S. 21-314(F)).
fields_withheld: Dates of birth, addresses, phone numbers and e-mail (Ariz. R. Sup. Ct. 123(e)(10))
All questionnaire information that identifies a juror, including citizenship answers (Rule 123(e)(10))
Juror name list, unless law or a court order requires release (A.R.S. 21-312(A)); Rule 123(e)(10) exempts master-list names, but the statute still applies
jury_list.official_pipeline: A.R.S. 21-314(F) (as amended by Laws 2022, ch. 370 (HB 2243)): the jury commissioner sends the Secretary of State and the county recorder a summary report of persons who say they are not U.S. citizens or do not live in the county. A.R.S. 16-165(A)(10): the recorder sends a forwardable notice; with no satisfactory evidence of citizenship within 35 days, the recorder cancels and notifies the county attorney and the attorney general. Federal court: cancellation under 16-165(A)(10) is enjoined within 90 days before a federal election (Mi Familia Vota v. Fontes, D. Ariz. final judgment May 2, 2024; aff'd 9th Cir. Feb. 25, 2025; cert. granted June 29, 2026, No. 25-1017).

sources.cite: A.R.S. 21-314 (jury commissioner reports non-citizens to SoS and county recorder)
A.R.S. 16-165(A)(10) (recorder notice, 35 days, cancellation, referral to county attorney and AG)
Laws 2022, ch. 370 (HB 2243), sec. 3: amends 21-314(F) from a redacted copy of the questionnaire to a 'summary report'

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person, on request to the county recorder or Secretary of State, but only for a use the statute allows (A.R.S. 16-168(E)). Public lists carry name, party, registration date and address (16-168(B)); party-chair copies carry birth year only (16-168(C)(8)).
voter_file.permitted_uses: Political, campaign, election and redistricting purposes, or other uses authorized by law. Commercial use is barred (A.R.S. 16-168(E)).
voter_file.use_restriction: A.R.S. 16-168(E): 'Precinct registers and other lists and information derived from registration forms may be used only for purposes relating to a political or political party activity, a political campaign or an election, for revising election district boundaries or for any other purpose specifically authorized by law and may not be used for a commercial purpose as defined in section 39-121.03.'
voter_file.penalty: A.R.S. 16-168(F): a person who posts precinct lists or registration data on the internet, or who uses or allows use for a purpose not authorized, is guilty of a class 6 felony.

private_challenge.who: At the polls only: any qualified elector of the county may orally challenge a person offering to vote (A.R.S. 16-591). That is contact with the voter at a polling place. JuryRoll does not support it.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: A.R.S. 16-591, 16-592 (oral challenge at the polls); 16-552(C)-(E) (written early-ballot challenges by party-appointed challengers; burden on the challenger); 16-121.01(B) (presumption of valid registration; clear and convincing evidence to rebut).
private_challenge.evidence_standard: A.R.S. 16-121.01(B): a registered person is presumed properly registered; a challenger must show clear and convincing evidence.

county_board.name: County recorders and election offices (Arizona Secretary of State directory)
county_board.note: The county recorder receives jury non-citizen notices under A.R.S. 21-314(F).

ag.name: Arizona Attorney General
ag.note: The recorder refers unresolved cases to the AG and county attorney (A.R.S. 16-165(A)(10)).

audit_path.what_you_can_request: Ask the Secretary of State for its quarterly reports to the legislature under A.R.S. 16-165(M). Paragraph 3 gives 'the number of persons who have stated on a jury questionnaire that the person is not a United States citizen, the number of notices sent' and 'the number of registrations that have been canceled as a result of those notices.' Ask the county recorder for list-maintenance records under 52 U.S.C. 20507(i). Ask for counts only. Do not ask for names.
audit_path.note: A request for an existing public record goes under A.R.S. 39-121. Whether the 21-314(F) summary report itself is open is unverified (null); it names persons, so JuryRoll never asks for it. The county recorder also posts counts of registrants without proof of citizenship (A.R.S. 16-161(B)).

gates.basis: Juror records are closed (A.R.S. 21-312; Ariz. R. Sup. Ct. 123(e)(10)), so jury_list.public is false: no jury list, counts only. The only private challenge is oral, at the polls (A.R.S. 16-591), and the presumption of valid registration yields only to clear and convincing evidence (16-121.01(B)). allowed stays null. Gates F/T/F/F.

notes: RE-VERIFIED 2026-10-09 (review/AZ.reverify-2026-10-09.md): A.R.S. 21-312, 21-314 and 16-168(E) text unchanged. RNC v. Mi Familia Vota, No. 25-1017: set for argument Dec. 8, 2026 (docket, read 2026-10-09). Not re-checked today: 16-165, 16-591, 16-121.01, Rule 123. No gate change.

CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). Strict choices: dob_in_public_file false; openness of the 21-314(F) report null; a jury-report cancellation under 16-165(A)(10) is treated as inside the 90-day ban; private_challenge.allowed null. RNC v. Mi Familia Vota, No. 25-1017 (cert. granted June 29, 2026; argument Dec. 8, 2026) is pending. Open questions are in review/NULLS-SUMMARY.md. 2026-10-07 (Optimus final rulings, REQ-NOTE 65): voter_file.use_restriction added with the exact statutory text (filled from the statute); the app shows it and requires the user's attestation before the voter file loads.
allowed is null: Arizona law lets an elector challenge at the polls (A.R.S. 16-591). No written pre-election challenge by a private person was found. The app treats null as no challenge guidance.
Duplication: the official pipeline already exists (A.R.S. 21-314(F) and 16-165(A)(10)). Aggregate referral should ask whether it ran.
Posting registration data on the internet is a class 6 felony (A.R.S. 16-168(F)). JuryRoll never posts data.
state_extra_days is 0: no state window that starts before day 90 was found in the reviewed challenge statutes.

dob_in_public_file is false: precinct lists sold to any person carry name, party, registration date and address (16-168(B)). Party chairs get birth year only (16-168(C)(8)). Month and day of birth are not accessible except to the voter, officials, NVRA agencies, petition checks, 'for election purposes', news gathering or by court order (16-168(F)). Whether a private person can claim 'election purposes' is an Optimus question. Best tier on a lawful public list: name + birth year, which is not a strong match.

No lawful named-data path for a private person was found. The jury list is closed (21-312). The 21-314(F) report names persons; its openness under 39-121 is unverified, and it would carry 16-168 use limits if derived from registration data. Posting or misusing voter data is a class 6 felony (16-168(F)).
No private-complaint provision exists in 16-165, HB 2243 (Laws 2022, ch. 370) or HB 2492 (ch. 99). Verified 2026-10-07 by text search of both session laws.

Mi Familia Vota final judgment (May 2, 2024): 16-165(A)(10) cancellation is enjoined within 90 days before a federal election; 16-165(I) ('reason to believe' SAVE checks of registered voters) is permanently enjoined. The 9th Circuit affirmed (Feb. 25, 2025); rehearing en banc denied Sept. 22, 2025. Cert. granted June 29, 2026 (No. 25-1017) on two questions: state-form proof of citizenship, and the 90-day cancellation program. 16-165(I) is not in the questions presented. Argument Dec. 8, 2026.

Federal-only voters: registrants without satisfactory evidence of citizenship (16-166) vote federal races only, not in presidential elections or by mail (16-127(A)); the final judgment enjoins those two limits as preempted by NVRA sec. 6. The recorder posts their count (16-161(B)). This status is not proof of non-citizenship.
Pending: HB 4067 (2026, 57th Leg. 2R) would add a pollbook status for registrants who self-report as noncitizen or nonresident on a jury questionnaire (16-583). Enactment status: null (unverified).

90-day ban: JuryRoll treats every 16-165(A)(10) cancellation, including one based on a 21-314(F) jury report, as inside the injunction's 90-day ban. Whether a jury-report cancellation is 'individualized' is open (review/NULLS-SUMMARY.md).
